## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- LicenseStore key generation + verification
- generates a PRISM-<ABBR>-<rand>-<sig> key that verifies
- rejects a tampered key (signature mismatch)
- rejects malformed keys (wrong prefix, wrong shape, unknown product abbr)
- a key signed under a different secret does NOT verify (proves signing)
- unknown product cannot generate a key
